# js-build

Build output and caches of JavaScript frameworks and bundlers. They are recreated on the next build.

**Name:** JavaScript build output · **Category:** Project artifacts · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

## In projects

| Folder | Only when | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{.next,.nuxt,.svelte-kit,.turbo,.parcel-cache,.angular,.expo,storybook-static,.vite,.docusaurus}` | next to `package.json` | Safe; Review if the project was used recently | Your build tools recreate this automatically (`REGENERABLE`) | `quarantine` |
| `{dist,build,coverage,out}` | next to `package.json`; git ignores it | Safe; Review if the project was used recently | Your build tools recreate this automatically (`REGENERABLE`) | `quarantine` |
